ja.fit_body: 何度も続く仕事があり、資料が散らばり、Agent やパソコンを替えても前回の続きから始めたい場合に向いています。開発、執筆、Web サイト、ローカル AI の管理にも使えます。

en.fit_body: Use it for work that continues over time: scattered material, changing agents or computers, and a need to resume from real progress. A software project, manuscript, website, or local AI setup can each start in one folder.
fit_points: You need to recover the last verified state
You maintain projects, services, works, or tools
You want to separate completion from real verification
en.not_fit_body: For a one-off answer, translation, or file lookup, just do the task. Qiming does not automatically control other folders and does not replace specialist tools, real acceptance, or your authorization for risky actions.
not_fit_points: The task ends after one answer
